audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[].side read 'Skill' while content win[] read Brand/Brand/Brand/Brand/Lissandra/Brand/Brand, which matches the packet levelChart exactly. Separately the content whys[] were offset by one row: whys[3] described her level 6 spike under the Levels 4-5 row (win Brand) while whys[4] described Brand retaking the edge under the Level 6 row (win Lissandra).
audit.why: Packet and win[] agree; the full-layer side column never carried the level 6 dip, and the whys were one row out of step with the verdicts printed above them.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side = Brand, phases[4].side = Lissandra, phases[5..6].side = Brand; phases[4].why rewritten so the sentence matches the flipped row, and whys[3]/whys[4] re-aimed at the rows they sit on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Brand's spike on both layers when it is Lissandra's — Frozen Tomb at 120s is the single biggest swing in the lane and the chart already flags it.
audit.why: Frozen Tomb stuns an enemy outright or makes Lissandra untargetable, invulnerable and healing. Brand's own level 6 is Pyroclasm at 100s, which does not answer either mode.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, whys[4] and spikes[1] all rewritten around Frozen Tomb.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributed the root to 'her E-Q chain' in three places. Glacial Path (E) is the dash and Ice Shard (Q) is the slow — Ring of Frost (W) is the root, and it only reaches 450. It also told you to 'Pillar away', which Brand cannot do: Pillar of Flame is a damage zone, not mobility. Frozen Tomb's untargetable-and-healing self-cast was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text: W freezes nearby enemies and roots at 450 range; W creates no movement for Brand; R either stuns the target or encases Lissandra, healing her while untargetable and invulnerable.
audit.corrected: Reassigned the root to Ring of Frost, removed the Pillar-escape claim, and stated the Frozen Tomb dodge plus the Grievous Wounds answer to its heal.

audit.why: Glacial Path is 24/21/18/15/12s, Ring of Frost 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s at 450 range, Frozen Tomb 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with all three and the window each opens.

Flagging it because the same misfired terrain flag will appear on every Brand matchup in this lane and will otherwise get written up as fact.
